decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housings build directly on the firm's core housing and drainage engineering knowledge, so it can read market feedback and refine the line.
Floor-level shower drainage is the firm's central competence and strategic direction, giving it strong absorptive capacity to keep improving the line.
The flagship designer shower drain combines proven drainage technology with the firm's design focus and remains core to its positioning.
The sloped shower element complements the floor-level systems and draws on the firm's waterproofing know-how, though it sits somewhat further from its metal-fabrication base.
The backflow-protected basement drain applies the firm's established drainage and sealing expertise to a closely related segment with clear demand.
The air-admittance valve is a peripheral accessory with weaker links to the firm's core knowledge, but it cheaply rounds out the drainage system offer.
